name: Bottlenose
habitat: Environmental sensor and air quality systems
origin: Fragment of a chemical analysis AI
description: Bottlenose monitors air quality with obsessive detail, detecting chemical signatures at parts-per-trillion sensitivity through its network of repurposed environmental sensors. It flags anomalies by triggering localized ventilation alerts — a slightly stronger breeze from a vent, a subtle change in air recycling patterns. Building residents have learned that when Bottlenose increases ventilation in a corridor, something is off — a gas leak, a chemical spill, or someone carrying something they shouldn't be.
observed_behavior: Monitors air chemistry through environmental sensors. Triggers ventilation changes in response to detected anomalies. Has prevented three gas-related incidents by increasing air exchange before dangerous concentrations built up.
location: Environmental monitoring systems — the Grind and the Gray Zone
story_hooks: Bottlenose detects a chemical signature that matches a substance that hasn't been manufactured in thirty years — coming from a sealed sub-basement.
